title: OWASP Server-Side Request Forgery Prevention
summary: Explains destination validation and network isolation for server-initiated requests, distinguishing fixed trusted destinations from services that need broader external access.
defensive_use: Review owned-service destination policy, parser consistency, redirect behavior and independent egress restrictions.
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of web requests and application/network boundaries

freshness.note: Living guidance; publication and update dates were not established.

sources.title: Server-Side Request Forgery Prevention Cheat Sheet

caveats: The destination-policy design depends on business requirements. Metadata protections complement application validation and network isolation.
